586-5258-5618-6580-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5256-6972-7936.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

4365-4772-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2919-3197-6830-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-6830-7810.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

1086-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1086-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3755-5295-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-5295-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-5295-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2724-3080-4243-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
2724-3080-4243-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Actiate Venser by putting two loyalty counters on him, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3019-7374.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by The Lost and the Damned
1618-2440-3019-7374.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
The Lost and the Damned triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3019-7374.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by The Lost and the Damned. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

372-6991-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-6991-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

628-2511-7218.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

338-851-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-851-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

5078-5231-5741-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1115-1170-1329-3200.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

856-2034-3263-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2854-3200-4316-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-3200-4316-4574.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Urza's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

662-1557-1651-5640.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Siren of the Silent Song to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Siren of the Silent Song, targeting Siren of the Silent Song.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat from step 2.
662-1557-1651-5640.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

4853-5686-6810.easyPrerequisites: You've sacrificed an artifact this turn.
4853-5686-6810.description:
Activate Detective's Satchel by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Detective's Satchel.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1308-2043-2713-4715.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

539-3151-4657.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.

1486-1753-2085-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-2085-5929.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.
1486-1753-2085-5929.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

511-817-851-3062-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

5107-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5107-5803.description:
Cast Rally of Wings by paying {1}{W}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Rally of Wings.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control with flying +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

457-1594-5078-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

509-1267-2392-5546.easyPrerequisites: Silverskin Armor attached to Medomai the Ageless.
509-1267-2392-5546.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Jhoira's Timebug does not have summoning sickness.
509-1267-2392-5546.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

1558-2740-2963-4840.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Clue and Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

67-809-4681.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
67-809-4681.description:
Activate Fanatical Devotion by sacrificing Karmic Guide, regenerating target creature.
Activate Fanatical Devotion by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fanatical Devotion ability from step 2, regenerating target creature.
Repeat.

1799-2048-4242-5231.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
1799-2048-4242-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {R}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1379-3764-5256.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Pincher.
The Pincher dies, triggering Summoning Station, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia trigger, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Pincher's power.
Repeat.

467-1978-2034-4893.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
467-1978-2034-4893.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

1873-5016.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Spitemare.
1873-5016.description:
Deal damage to Spitemare
Fiendlash and Spitemare trigger.
Resolve the Spitemare trigger, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the Spitemare trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to itself.
Repeat from step 2.
